title: create OTA plan
description: roll out a firmware update as a template-to-template migration

details.label: details
details.description: name and describe the update plan
details.title: Plan details
details.subtitle: Give the rollout a recognizable name and an optional description

name.label: plan name
name.hint: shown on the plans list and the detail drawer

schedule.label: schedule
schedule.description: run immediately or at a future time
schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Choose when the rollout starts and when it must finish

field.label: start at
field.required: pick the start date and time
field.future: the start must be in the future

maxTime.label: deadline
maxTime.hint: pending devices time out and the rollout closes at this time
maxTime.afterStart: the deadline must be after the start

pacing.title: Pacing and safety
pacing.abortThresholdHint: abort the rollout when the failure rate crosses this

fromTemplate.label: source template
fromTemplate.description: which template the devices run today
fromTemplate.title: Source template
fromTemplate.subtitle: Pick the template the devices are currently on — its devices become the candidates for this rollout

devices.label: devices
devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Choose which devices on the source template receive this update

toTemplate.label: target template
toTemplate.description: the version of record devices migrate to
toTemplate.title: Target template
toTemplate.subtitle: Pick the template devices switch to after reporting a successful update

firmware.versionHint: the version the device reports after applying the update

dropzone.title: drag the .bin here or click to browse
dropzone.hint: one binary per plan — the platform validates size and SHA-256 on finalize

messages.createError: failed to create the OTA plan

devices.noAssets: no devices on the source template
